description: Lets an independently authorized replacement agent continue a commitment. Reconciles the authoritative state, verifies the caller's EIP-712 authority proof, and executes the requested nonfinancial transition through the canonical transition engine. The replacement agent must hold its OWN durable authorization (no automatic inheritance). Duplicate requests are idempotent. Financial transitions (settle/finalize with settlement, escrow release, refunds) are NOT exposed. For inspection first, use get_recovery_status or get_pending_actions.

action.description: The lifecycle action to execute: cancel, accept, authorize, execute, complete, submit, verify, fulfill, recover, dispute (nonfinancial subset)

authorityRef.description: Optional external authority reference to record on the event

evidenceRef.description: Optional evidence reference to bind to the transition

expectedVersion.description: Optimistic-concurrency guard: the state version the caller observed

idempotencyRef.description: Caller-scoped idempotency reference (>= 8 chars) for safe retries

proof.description: EIP-712 AuthorityProof signed by the caller (issuer = signer)

role.description: The caller's role on this commitment

name: resume_commitment
title: Resume a commitment after the original agent terminated
